parrafo_1.es: Supreme Power Washing es el negocio de Matt en Lakeland. Él mismo visita la propiedad, explica el proceso y hace el trabajo: adoquines, techos, fachadas, cercas y pool decks, con sellado incluido cuando hace falta.
parrafo_1.en: Supreme Power Washing is Matt's business in Lakeland. He visits the property himself, walks you through the process and does the work: pavers, roofs, siding, fences and pool decks, with sealing included when the job needs it.

parrafo_2.es: Es uno de los pocos en la zona certificado por Trident para aplicar el sellador Cyclone Cat 5, el dato que una clienta confirmó directamente con el fabricante antes de contratarlo.
parrafo_2.en: He is one of the few people in the area trained by Trident to apply their Cyclone Cat 5 sealant, something one customer confirmed directly with the manufacturer before hiring him.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas limpiar: driveway, techo, patio o fachada.
texto.en: Tell us what needs cleaning: a driveway, a roof, a patio or siding.

texto.es: Matt revisa la propiedad en persona y explica el proceso antes de dar el precio.
texto.en: Matt walks the property in person and explains the process before giving a price.

texto.es: Lavado a presión o suave según la superficie, con el tiempo que haga falta para hacerlo bien.
texto.en: Pressure or soft wash depending on the surface, taking whatever time it needs to do it right.

texto.es: En adoquines, deja secar y aplica sellador certificado para que el color dure.
texto.en: On pavers, he lets everything dry and applies certified sealant so the color lasts.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según la superficie y el estado. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the surface and its condition. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Concreto y adoquines recuperan su color; sellado certificado Trident incluido si lo necesitas.
texto.en: Concrete and pavers get their color back; certified Trident sealing included if you need it.

texto.es: Lavado suave que quita las manchas oscuras sin dañar la teja.
texto.en: Soft wash that lifts the dark stains without damaging the tile.

texto.es: Paredes, cercas y screen enclosures libres de moho y manchas.
texto.en: Walls, fences and screen enclosures free of mold and grime.

texto.es: El área de la piscina limpia, pareja y lista para usarse.
texto.en: The pool area clean, even and ready to enjoy.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your project listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Matt, the owner of Supreme Power Washing, was very professional and friendly. He provided an on site inspection and quote and explained the process. Of the 4 quotes I received he was the only one to do this. My pool deck looks great.

Matt and his crew were very professional in every way. They showed up on time and the work area was clean when they left. We were also pleased with the price and the quality of their products and services.

Excellent response upon 1st meet. Thorough discussion about how the process is done. Pressure wash was impressive as my home had not been done for quite a while. They were careful, thorough and clean. I will use them again.
